settings.heading: Questions, answered.
settings.text: Everything you need before you order.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Most orders are processed quickly and delivered according to the shipping estimate shown at checkout. Delivery times can vary by location.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Yes. Once your order is dispatched, tracking information will be provided so you can follow its progress.

settings.question: What if my product arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact KitchiFix support as soon as possible with your order details and clear photos of the package and product. We will help with the next steps.

settings.question: Are KitchiFix products easy to use?
settings.answer: Yes. KitchiFix focuses on practical kitchen upgrades designed to be intuitive, useful and easy to fit into everyday routines.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Returns depend on the applicable store return policy and the condition of the item. Please check the current return policy before ordering.

settings.question: How can I contact KitchiFix?
settings.answer: Use the contact details provided in the store footer or contact page and include your order number when asking about an existing order.
